interface.authorityModel: Only the reviewed hook address may call the executor; an explicit owner rotates that hook after a delayed onchain update.
interface.rotationProcess: The current owner proposes a new hook, waits through the configured delay, executes the change, and publishes the receipt.
interface.profitPolicy: Each successful call settles the declared creator and treasury shares before returning; a failed leg reverts the whole operation.

requirements: Fork the target chain and exercise the exact production caller authorization.
Assert authorization, both swaps, profit accounting, and postcondition readback separately.
